verdict.rationale: Notion ships its own built-in agents. The homepage pitches 'Keep work moving 24/7 with agents' and instant answers with citations. The Agent APIs document Custom Agents with chat sessions, action submission, event history, usage tracking and credit limits, so delegating tasks to a first-party in-product assistant is clearly the core offering. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the in-app delegation experience (beyond taglines and API references), any independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete as claimed.
